Cradle of Life: Casting Heavy Attack consumes up to 2 stacks of Cradle of Life. For every 1 {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=6} of Cradle of Life consumed, Heavy Attack DMG ignores 15%–25% of the target's DEF, up to 30%–50%. The effect lasts for 2s.
